books.title: A Guide for Midwifery Skills
books.description: A practical skills manual produced by the midwifery service of Mater Dei Hospital. Covers admission, monitoring during labor, assisting delivery, immediate newborn care and emergency procedures, with step-by-step protocols suitable for midwifery training.
books.author: Mater Dei Hospital

books.title: A Guide to Common Childhood Infections
books.description: A school-focused reference on infectious disease spread, prevention, and exclusion rules for children. Covers chickenpox, COVID-19, influenza, measles, RSV, and more with clear reporting guidance.
books.author: Lambton Public Health
books.cover_alt: A Guide to Common Childhood Infections

books.title: A Guideline for the Management of Caesarean Section
books.description: A practical NHS protocol covering caesarean classification, duties of the surgical team, procedures for emergency and elective CS and postoperative care. Includes appendices on enhanced recovery and consent.
books.author: Wye Valley NHS Trust
books.cover_alt: A Guideline for the Management of Caesarean Section

books.title: ANA's Principles for Nursing Documentation
books.description: Official ANA guide identifying six essential principles for nursing documentation, covering communication within healthcare teams, protection systems, and standardized terminologies.
books.author: American Nurses Association

books.title: Anatomy & Physiology
books.description: Comprehensive anatomy and physiology textbook adapted from OpenStax by Oregon State University. Covers all body systems from cellular to organ level with detailed illustrations and chapter exercises. Revised 2nd edition (2022).
books.author: Lindsay M. Biga, Staci Bronson, Sierra Dawson, Amy Harwell, Robin Hopkins and others

books.title: Anatomy and Physiology
books.description: Introductory anatomy and physiology module from Sri Satya Sai University of Technology and Medical Sciences. Covers all body systems with clear learning objectives, from cells and tissues to nutrition and sports physiology.
books.author: Dr. Minakshi Pathak

books.title: Anatomy and Physiology 2e
books.description: The updated 2nd edition (2022) of the OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology textbook from Rice University. Covers all 28 units on body systems with peer-reviewed content, detailed illustrations, and review exercises. CC BY 4.0 licensed.
books.author: J. Gordon Betts, Peter Desaix, Eddie Johnson, Jody E. Johnson, Oksana Korol, Dean Kruse, Brandon Poe, James A. Wise, Mark Womble and Kelly A. Young

books.title: Anatomy, Physiology and Pathophysiology
books.description: Course notes for pharmacy students from Victor Babes University of Medicine and Pharmacy (Romania, 2023). Covers cardiovascular, blood, respiratory, digestive, urinary, and endocrine systems with pathophysiology integrated into each chapter.
books.author: Alexandra Mioc and Savoiu Germaine

books.title: Applied Human Anatomy
books.description: Open textbook from Virginia Tech Carilion School of Medicine focusing on applied clinical anatomy. Authors bring 60+ years of combined anatomy teaching experience with a practical, clinically-oriented approach.
books.author: Michael F. Nolan and John P. McNamara

books.title: Art of Communication. A Nurses Guide to Implementing Best Practice in Communication
books.description: A practical guide on communication skills for nurses by EDTNA/ERCA. Covers communication types, styles, common mistakes, and advanced skills like shared decision making. Includes case studies.
books.author: EDTNA/ERCA
books.cover_alt: Art of Communication. A Nurses Guide to Implementing Best Practice in Communication

books.title: Basic Clinical Nursing Skills
books.description: Lecture notes covering basic clinical nursing skills including the nursing process, patient assessment, vital signs, wound care, and medication administration. Developed by the Ethiopia Public Health Training Initiative.
books.author: Abraham Alano

books.title: Basic First Aid Manual
books.description: Covers biological hazards, primary survey, cardiac arrest, choking, bleeding, fractures, burns, bites and stings, poisoning, and drowning. A well-structured guide for first responders and community training.
books.author: State Disaster Management Authority

books.title: Basic Life Support Provider Handbook (2025)
books.description: Updated to 2025 guidelines, this handbook covers adult, child, and infant CPR, AED use, airway management, and choking relief. Includes step-by-step algorithms and self-assessment questions.
books.author: Dr. Karl Disque

books.title: Bright Futures: Health Supervision Pocket Guide
books.description: The AAP pocket guide every pediatrician keeps at hand. Summarizes well-child visits, developmental milestones, anticipatory guidance, and screening recommendations from infancy through adolescence.
books.author: American Academy of Pediatrics
books.cover_alt: Bright Futures: Health Supervision Pocket Guide

books.title: Caesarean Section Birth Guideline
books.description: A 2023 NHS Trust guideline aligned with NICE NG192. Covers caesarean classification, antenatal counselling, anaesthetic options, intraoperative steps and recovery pathways, with appendices for emergency CS flowcharts and impacted fetal head management.
books.author: University Hospitals Sussex NHS Trust

books.title: Caesarean Section: Clinical Guideline
books.description: The full NICE clinical guideline on caesarean section: indications, planned versus emergency procedures, anaesthesia, surgical technique, postoperative care and risks for future pregnancies. Funded by the NHS to set the UK standard of practice.
books.author: National Collaborating Centre for Women and Children Health

books.title: Cardiac Pharmacology
books.description: Accredited nursing continuing education course covering cardiac pharmacology, including antiarrhythmics, antihypertensives, vasodilators, and thrombolytic medications.
books.author: Jassin M. Jouria

books.title: Child Growth and Development
books.description: An open educational textbook that walks through child development from conception to adolescence. Covers physical growth, cognition, language, emotional milestones, and family context.
books.author: Jennifer Paris, Antoinette Ricardo, Dawn Rymond

books.title: Clinical Guide to Ophthalmic Drugs
books.description: Comprehensive clinical reference for ophthalmic drugs covering allergy treatments, antibiotics, dry eye therapy, glaucoma medications, and corticosteroid use.
books.author: Ron Melton and Randall Thomas

books.title: Clinical Pharmacology in Health Care, Teaching and Research
books.description: WHO position paper on clinical pharmacology covering drug therapy in pediatric and geriatric patients, biologics, traditional medicines, and the discipline role in global health.
books.author: WHO/IUPHAR/CIOMS
books.cover_alt: Clinical Pharmacology in Health Care, Teaching and Research

books.title: Code of Professional Conduct and Ethics for Registered Nurses and Registered Midwives
books.description: A comprehensive professional code covering six principles (respect, accountability, competence, trust, collaboration, leadership), scope of practice, record keeping, social media, and research ethics. 2025 edition.
books.author: NMBI
books.cover_alt: Code of Professional Conduct and Ethics for Registered Nurses and Registered Midwives

books.title: Common Childhood Illnesses: A Guide for Parents and Carers
books.description: A parent-friendly NHS handbook for handling everyday illnesses in children under five. Covers fever, rashes, coughs, ear infections, and when to seek urgent medical help.
books.author: NHS
books.cover_alt: Common Childhood Illnesses: A Guide for Parents and Carers

books.title: Drugs Used in Obstetrics
books.description: A compact pharmacology overview of the main drugs used in obstetrics: oxytocin, ergometrine, prostaglandins, antihypertensives, tocolytics, anticonvulsants and analgesics. Includes notes on fetal effects and lactation safety.
books.author: South Valley University

books.title: Ethics for Nurses: Theory and Practice
books.description: A comprehensive textbook on nursing ethics covering moral philosophy, ethical frameworks, professional regulation, consent, confidentiality, safeguarding, and end-of-life ethical decisions.
books.author: Pam Cranmer, Jean Nhemachena
books.cover_alt: Ethics for Nurses: Theory and Practice

books.title: Evidence-Based Practice: A Practice Manual
books.description: A practical manual for implementing evidence-based practice in clinical settings. Co-developed with the Centre for Evidence-Based Medicine, Oxford. Covers formulating questions, searching evidence, critical appraisal, and integration.
books.author: Brendan Leen, Miriam Bell, Patricia McQuillan

books.title: First Aid (FM 4-25.11)
books.description: The official U.S. military field manual covering airway management, bleeding control, shock treatment, fractures, burns, and environmental injuries. Written for service members but valuable for anyone seeking thorough first aid training.
books.author: U.S. Department of the Army

books.title: First Aid for First Responders in Africa
books.description: A comprehensive manual covering CPR, AED, catastrophic bleeding, gunshot wounds, spinal injuries, burns, road traffic incidents, and mass-casualty management. Evidence-based and richly illustrated.
books.author: Belgian Red Cross
books.cover_alt: First Aid for First Responders in Africa

books.title: First Aid In Brief
books.description: Published by the International Committee of the Red Cross, this illustrated pocket guide covers essential first aid procedures including wound care, burns, fractures, and casualty assessment. Designed for use in any setting worldwide.
books.author: International Committee of the Red Cross

books.title: First Aid Manual
books.description: A compact reference covering CPR, AED, choking, anaphylaxis, bleeding, burns, fractures, strokes, seizures, and pediatric emergencies. Designed as a course companion for workplace first aid training.
books.author: First Response Training

books.title: First Aid Reference Guide
books.description: Covers CPR, AED use, choking, burns, fractures, poisons, and over 30 emergency conditions. A practical companion for trained first aiders and anyone who wants to respond effectively in a crisis.
books.author: St John Ambulance

books.title: First Aid, Survival, and CPR: Home and Field Pocket Guide
books.description: Covers basic safety, CPR, choking, medical emergencies, natural disasters, outdoor survival, poisons, and pet first aid. A portable reference for home and field use.
books.author: Shirley A. Jones
books.cover_alt: First Aid, Survival, and CPR: Home and Field Pocket Guide

books.title: Fundamental of Nursing Procedure Manual
books.description: A step-by-step nursing procedure manual covering basic nursing care, medication administration, and specimen collection. Developed by JICA and Khwopa Polytechnic Institute for nursing students.
books.author: JICA. Japan International Cooperation Agency

books.title: Fundamentals of Anatomy and Physiology
books.description: University of Southern Queensland adaptation of OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology. Organized into 13 parts covering all body systems, from cells and tissues to reproduction. Includes specialized blood and cardiovascular chapters.
books.author: Anna Chruscik, Kate Kauter, Louisa Windus and Eliza Whiteside

books.title: General Pharmacology and Pharmacology of Drugs Affecting the Nervous System
books.description: University pharmacology tutorial covering pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, autonomic nervous system drugs, and CNS medications. Includes drug classifications and clinical applications.
books.author: Germanyuk T.A., Bobruk V.P., Lysogora V.V.
books.cover_alt: General Pharmacology and Pharmacology of Drugs Affecting the Nervous System

books.title: Guidelines for Consultation with Obstetric and Related Medical Services
books.description: New Zealand referral guidelines that define when a midwife should consult or transfer care to an obstetrician or specialist. Lists specific antenatal, intrapartum and postnatal conditions with the recommended level of consultation.
books.author: The New Zealand Ministry of Health
books.cover_alt: Guidelines for Consultation with Obstetric and Related Medical Services

books.title: Human Anatomy and Physiology
books.description: Lecture notes for nursing students developed by the Ethiopia Public Health Training Initiative with The Carter Center. Covers all body systems using a systemic approach with learning objectives and review questions per chapter.
books.author: Nega Assefa, Alemaya University, Yosief Tsige and Jimma University

books.title: ICM Essential Competencies for Midwifery Practice 2024
books.description: The 2024 update of the international competency standard for midwives. Defines the knowledge, skills and behaviors required across antenatal, intrapartum, postnatal and newborn care, used worldwide as the benchmark for midwifery education and regulation.
books.author: International Confederation of Midwives
books.cover_alt: ICM Essential Competencies for Midwifery Practice 2024

books.title: Instant Clinical Pharmacology
books.description: Concise clinical pharmacology guide covering pharmacokinetics, dosing in special populations, adverse drug reactions, drug interactions, and principles of therapeutics.
books.author: Evan J. Begg

books.title: Introduction to Pediatrics
books.description: A full academic introduction to pediatric medicine, from newborn assessment and growth to common infectious diseases, nutrition, and WHO health data. Prepared by the YSMU Department of Pediatrics.
books.author: Yerevan State Medical University

books.title: Lecture Notes in Clinical Pharmacology
books.description: Comprehensive clinical pharmacology lecture notes covering 50 topics from basic drug mechanisms to antimicrobials, cardiovascular drugs, CNS pharmacology, and skin pharmacology.
books.author: Teaching Staff of Pharmacology Dept, University of Basrah

books.title: Manual of Standard Managements in Obstetrics and Gynaecology for Doctors H E O s and Nurses in Papua New Guinea
books.description: The sixth edition of a frontline clinical manual for doctors, health extension officers and nurses. Covers family planning, antenatal care, intrapartum management, complications and gynaecology emergencies with practical instructions designed for low-resource settings.
books.author: IdMicro
books.cover_alt: Manual of Standard Managements in Obstetrics and Gynaecology for Doctors H E O s and Nurses in Papua New Guinea

books.title: Notes on Nursing. What It Is, and What It Is Not
books.description: Florence Nightingale's foundational 1859 text on nursing principles, covering ventilation, hygiene, nutrition, observation, and patient care. A classic that shaped modern nursing practice.
books.author: Florence Nightingale
books.cover_alt: Notes on Nursing. What It Is, and What It Is Not

books.title: Nursing Advanced Skills
books.description: An Open RN textbook covering advanced nursing skills including IV therapy, blood product administration, central line management, chest tube drainage, and basic ECG interpretation.
books.author: Open RN

books.title: Nursing Care at the End of Life
books.description: An open textbook on end-of-life nursing care covering palliative care models, pain and symptom management, ethical concerns, nurse-patient communication, and grief. Written by a certified hospice nurse.
books.author: Susan E. Lowey
books.cover_alt: Nursing Care at the End of Life

books.title: Nursing Pharmacology
books.description: Nursing pharmacology course module covering drug fundamentals, the nursing process in medication administration, and drugs organized by body system.
books.author: Allan Rey Ramirez

books.title: Obstetric Complications and Treatment
books.description: A focused chapter on the four life-threatening obstetric complications: hemorrhage, obstructed labor, eclampsia and puerperal sepsis. Quantifies how often women experience each complication and what treatment is required, with maternal-mortality data tables.
books.author: The Demographic and Health Surveys

books.title: Obstetric Emergency Readiness Resource Kit
books.description: A 2023 readiness toolkit from the Alliance for Innovation on Maternal Health. Provides rapid response team setup, transfer logistics, simulation drills and clinical bundles for obstetric hemorrhage, severe hypertension, sepsis and venous thromboembolism in non-obstetric care settings.
books.author: Alliance for Innovation on Maternal Health

books.title: Pharmacology
books.description: Comprehensive pharmacology lecture notes covering pharmacodynamics, pharmacokinetics, and drug safety. Developed for health science students by the University of Gondar with Carter Center support.
books.author: The Carter Center

books.title: Pharmacology
books.description: Open access research compilation covering pharmacodynamics, pharmacogenetics, clinical pharmacology, and drug delivery. Features peer-reviewed chapters from international researchers.
books.author: Luca Gallelli

books.title: Pharmacology for Nurses. Part II
books.description: Nursing pharmacology course covering cardiac drugs, antihypertensives, CNS medications, and diuretics. Includes drug actions, dosages, side effects, and nursing considerations.
books.author: Dr. Nasser Abu-El-Noor

books.title: Quick Guide to Common Childhood Diseases
books.description: A school-ready A-to-Z reference on childhood infections from chickenpox to whooping cough. Each entry explains symptoms, spread, and when to keep a child home from school or daycare.
books.author: BC Centre for Disease Control
books.cover_alt: Quick Guide to Common Childhood Diseases

books.title: QuickStudy Anatomy
books.description: Dense visual reference chart with over 1,000 anatomical identifications covering all major body systems: skeletal, muscular, nervous, lymphatic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, endocrine, and reproductive. Includes bone structure and nerve pathways.
books.author: BarCharts Inc.

books.title: Study Guide for Human Anatomy
books.description: Comprehensive anatomy study guide with lecture and laboratory sections. Covers all body systems from cells to development, with dedicated lab practicals for skeletal, muscular, cardiovascular, and nervous systems. 4th Edition by Jacob Sapiro, Ph.D.
books.author: Jacob Sapiro

books.title: WHO Recommendations on Child Health
books.description: Consolidated WHO clinical recommendations for child health, covering pneumonia, diarrhea, malaria, malnutrition, and newborn care. Reviewed and approved by the WHO Guidelines Review Committee.
books.author: World Health Organization

books.title: Wilderness First Aid Curriculum and Doctrine Guidelines
books.description: Official 16-hour curriculum covering patient assessment, chest injuries, shock, head and spine injuries, bone and joint injuries, wounds, hypothermia, heat problems, lightning, and altitude illness.
books.author: Boy Scouts of America
books.cover_alt: Wilderness First Aid Curriculum and Doctrine Guidelines

books.title: Ages & Stages
books.description: A quick parents reference to developmental milestones from birth through five years. Outlines how children play, learn, speak, and move at each stage with tips to support growth.
books.author: Child Development Associates

books.title: Case Based Pediatrics For Medical Students and Residents
books.description: Over 700 pages of real clinical cases from the University of Hawaii. Covers primary care, growth, immunizations, common illnesses, and acute problems with worked-through patient scenarios.
books.author: Loren G. Yamamoto,Alson S. Inaba, Jeffrey K. Okamoto
books.cover_alt: Case Based Pediatrics For Medical Students and Residents

books.title: Nursing Care of Children: Principles & Practice
books.description: A hands-on study companion for pediatric nursing students with exercises, case applications, and review questions across growth, assessment, medication, and acute care. Fourth edition by Elsevier/Saunders.
books.author: Susan Rowen James, Kristine Ann Nelson, Jean Weiler Ashwill
books.cover_alt: Nursing Care of Children: Principles & Practice

books.title: Nutrition for Nurses
books.description: OpenStax peer-reviewed textbook designed for nursing students, covering nutrition assessment, macronutrients, micronutrients, and nutrition across the lifespan with clinical applications.
books.author: Emerald Charity Bilbrew, Jody Vogelzang, Kelli Whittington

books.title: The Practical Course in Clinical Medicine
books.description: Step by step clinical skills guide from the Medical University of Lodz covering communication, physical examination, ECG analysis, resuscitation, suturing, catheterization, and ophthalmic and ENT exams for medical students.
books.author: Władysław Grabski, Dariusz Nowak
books.cover_alt: The Practical Course in Clinical Medicine

books.title: Basic Life Support Provider Handbook
books.description: Covers CPR techniques for adults, children, and infants, along with AED use, rescue breathing, and choking management. Follows American Heart Association standards with clear illustrations and review questions.
books.author: National Health Care Provider Solutions

books.title: Manual of Practical Parasitology
books.description: Practical laboratory manual from the University of Mosul College of Veterinary Medicine. Covers microscopy, sample preparation, diagnostic procedures and identification of parasites in farm animals through hands-on lab exercises.
books.author: Various Authors / University of Mosul

books.title: Basic Maternal and Newborn Care: A Guide for Skilled Providers
books.author: Barbara Kinzie, Patricia Gomez
books.cover_alt: Basic Maternal and Newborn Care: A Guide for Skilled Providers

books.title: Forensic Pathology
books.description: Lecture slides covering forensic science disciplines, crime scene investigation, evidence handling, the Locard Exchange Principle, and medicolegal procedures. From UST Faculty of Medicine.
books.author: Peter P. Ng

books.title: Forensic Pathology: A Handbook for Pathologists
books.description: Covers forensic autopsy procedures, postmortem chemistry, time of death estimation, identification methods, gunshot wounds, drowning, electrocution, and child abuse from a medicolegal perspective.
books.author: Russell S. Fisher, Charles S. Petty
books.cover_alt: Forensic Pathology: A Handbook for Pathologists

books.title: General and Cellular Pathology
books.description: University course covering cellular pathology events leading to disease, including practical sessions on biopsies and pots demonstration. Designed for nursing students.
books.author: National Open University of Nigeria

books.title: Internal Medicine Intern Survival Guide
books.description: Pocket handbook written for incoming internal medicine interns (2022 2023 edition) with quick reference protocols for nurse calls, electrolyte management, EKG interpretation, post procedure care, and common ward scenarios across cardiology, pulmonology, nephrology, gastroenterology, hematology, and infectious diseases.
books.author: Stephanie A. Howes

books.title: Psychiatric-Mental Health Nursing
books.description: A comprehensive open educational textbook on psychiatric and mental health nursing. Covers therapeutic communication, nursing assessment, care planning, crisis intervention, psychotropic medications, mood and anxiety disorders, schizophrenia spectrum, eating and substance use disorders, and community mental health.
books.author: Rebecca Puchkors, Jeanne Saunders, David Sharp

books.title: A Textbook of Advanced Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery Volume 3
books.description: Comprehensive 840-page textbook with 32 chapters by 93 specialists from nine countries. Covers dentoalveolar surgery, implants, orthognathic procedures, and maxillofacial reconstruction.
books.author: Mohammad Hosein Kalantar Motamedi
books.cover_alt: A Textbook of Advanced Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery Volume 3

books.title: Introduction to Oral Pathology
books.description: Course slides covering oral pathology fundamentals: hard tissue disorders, odontogenic cysts, TMD, salivary gland diseases, and mucosal lesions. From Faculty of Dental Medicine.
books.author: Omar Imran, Hasnaa' Makkawi

books.title: Molecular Pathology Resource Guide
books.description: Comprehensive resource covering molecular pathology applications across organ systems, genes by tumor type, and diagnostic tools for practicing pathologists.
books.author: College of American Pathologists

books.title: Pediatric Surgical Procedures - An Updated Guide Volume I
books.description: Modern 2025 update covering current pediatric surgical procedures including pectus excavatum correction, laparoscopic approaches, and advances in neonatal operative care.
books.author: Sherif Shehata
books.cover_alt: Pediatric Surgical Procedures - An Updated Guide Volume I

books.title: A Text Book of Food and Nutrition
books.description: Undergraduate textbook covering food groups, nutrients, digestion, metabolism, diet planning, and food preservation. Includes illustrations and exercises for each topic.
books.author: D.V. Ahirrao, N.H. Desale
books.cover_alt: A Text Book of Food and Nutrition

books.title: Basic epidemiology
books.description: The second edition of the WHO pillar textbook. Covers the logic of epidemiology, measures of disease frequency, study types, causation, and applications to communicable and noncommunicable disease control.
books.author: R bonita, R beaglehole

books.title: Dietary Guidelines for Americans 2015-2020
books.description: Official U.S. government dietary guidelines providing evidence-based nutritional advice, healthy eating patterns, food group recommendations, and strategies to reduce chronic disease risk.
books.author: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, USDA

books.title: Essential Nutrition Actions
books.description: WHO publication on mainstreaming nutrition through the life-course, covering maternal nutrition, infant and young child feeding, micronutrient supplementation, and nutrition in emergencies.
books.author: World Health Organization

books.title: Essentials of Human Nutrition
books.description: Authoritative textbook edited by two leading nutrition scientists from the Universities of Otago and Sydney. Covers nutrients, foods, nutrition-related diseases, and public health nutrition across 716 pages.
books.author: Jim Mann, A. Stewart Truswell

books.title: Family Nutrition Guide
books.description: FAO publication offering practical guidance on family meal planning, food groups, special nutritional needs for children and mothers, and strategies for healthy eating with limited resources.
books.author: Ann Burgess, Peter Glasauer

books.title: Foundations of Epidemiology
books.description: An open-access epidemiology textbook that walks through measures of disease frequency, surveillance, study designs, bias, confounding, effect modification, and screening. Structured for medical and public health students who want a complete conceptual foundation.
books.author: Marit L. Bovbjerg

books.title: Fundamentals of Foods, Nutrition and Diet Therapy
books.description: Comprehensive textbook covering food science, nutrition principles, diet therapy, vitamins, minerals, meal planning, and therapeutic diets for various health conditions. A well-established reference now in its 5th edition.
books.author: S.R. Mudambi, M.V. Rajagopal
books.cover_alt: Fundamentals of Foods, Nutrition and Diet Therapy

books.title: Human Nutrition
books.description: Extensive open-access textbook from the University of Hawaii covering nutrition fundamentals, the human body, macronutrients, micronutrients, energy balance, and lifespan nutrition across 1,200+ pages.
books.author: University of Hawai‘i at Mānoa Food Science and Human Nutrition Program

books.title: Introduction to Nutrition Science
books.description: Open-access textbook covering nutrition basics, healthy diets, digestion, macronutrients, micronutrients, lifespan nutrition, and food politics. Part of the LibreTexts OER platform.
books.author: LibreTexts Project

books.title: Manual of Clinical Nutrition Management
books.description: Detailed clinical reference covering normal and modified diets, transitional diets, carbohydrate and fat modification, fiber modification, renal nutrition, diabetes therapy, and enteral/parenteral nutrition support.
books.author: Compass Group / Morrison Inc

books.title: Animal Parasitology Laboratory Manual
books.description: Field-tested laboratory manual from Kansas State University Biology 625. Walks students through collecting, preserving, dissecting and mounting animal parasites for study, with line drawings of representative protozoa, trematodes, cestodes, nematodes and arthropods.
books.author: Steve J. Upton

books.title: Concepts in Animal Parasitology
books.description: Encyclopedic 862-page open access textbook on animal parasitology from the University of Nebraska. Brings together dozens of contributors covering protozoa, helminths, arthropods and ticks, with field methods, taxonomy and host-parasite ecology.
books.author: Scott L. Gardner, Sue Ann Gardner

books.title: Disaster Epidemiology: Assessing the Health Impacts of Environmental Public Health Disasters
books.description: A review of disaster epidemiology as a sub-discipline. Covers tracking, mitigation, and research tools used in disaster response, with lessons drawn from Fukushima and other environmental public health events.
books.author: Erik R. Svendsen
books.cover_alt: Disaster Epidemiology: Assessing the Health Impacts of Environmental Public Health Disasters

books.title: Human Parasitology Laboratory Manual
books.description: Laboratory manual from the Kansas State University BIOL 546 Human Parasitology course. Designed for hands-on identification of common eukaryotic parasites of humans, with detailed labeled drawings of trematodes, cestodes, nematodes and protozoa.
books.author: Kristin Michel, Kansas State University

books.title: Medical Parasitology
books.description: Medical parasitology textbook from Yerevan State Medical University. Covers protozoa, helminths and arthropods of medical importance, with clear explanations of life cycles, host-parasite relationships and the diagnosis of parasitic diseases.
books.author: Anna B. Semerjyan, Marina G. Susanyan

books.title: Physiotherapy Learner Guide
books.description: Comprehensive learner guide for physiotherapy assistants covering anatomy, body systems, treatment programs, and clinical procedures. Published by Queensland Health under Creative Commons license.
books.author: Queensland Health

books.title: Social Epidemiology: Definition, History, and Research Examples
books.description: A review article introducing the field of social epidemiology. Defines how social class, income distribution, and the bio-psychosocial paradigm shape the pattern of disease in a population, with concrete research examples.
books.author: Kaori Honjo
books.cover_alt: Social Epidemiology: Definition, History, and Research Examples

books.title: Acute Care: Integrated Management of Adolescent and Adult Illness
books.description: WHO IMAI module offering a syndromic approach to the most common adult and adolescent illnesses, with first level facility protocols for respiratory, gastrointestinal, febrile, neurologic, and opportunistic infection presentations including HIV care integration.
books.author: World Health Organization
books.cover_alt: Acute Care: Integrated Management of Adolescent and Adult Illness

books.title: Clinical guidelines - Diagnosis and treatment manual
books.description: MSF field manual (December 2024 edition) with diagnosis and treatment protocols across respiratory, gastrointestinal, skin, eye, parasitic, bacterial, viral, genito-urinary, and mental health conditions for curative care in hospitals and dispensaries.
books.author: Médecins Sans Frontières
books.cover_alt: Clinical guidelines - Diagnosis and treatment manual

books.title: Clinical Guidelines for Common Conditions
books.description: WHO supported clinical guidelines for hospital level management and referral of common conditions, with an extensive internal medicine section covering emergencies, infectious diseases, cardiovascular, respiratory, renal, gastrointestinal, endocrine, and hematologic disorders at secondary and tertiary facilities.
books.author: Ministry of Medical Services, World Health Organization

books.title: Clinical Pathology Course Handbook
books.description: Structured course handbook from Cambridge School of Clinical Medicine covering histopathology, chemical pathology, haematology, and immunology across all major organ systems.
books.author: University of Cambridge

books.title: General Pathology
books.description: Lecture notes covering ten chapters on cell injury, inflammation, healing, hemodynamic disorders, genetic diseases, immunopathology, neoplasia, and metabolic diseases. Funded by USAID and The Carter Center.
books.author: Mesele Bezabeh, Abiye Tesfaye

books.title: General Pathology Made Easy
books.description: Covers cell injury, inflammation, healing, neoplasia, hemodynamic and genetic disorders, immunopathology, and tropical diseases. Written in simple language for medical students.
